prompt: Ray paints the fence bright yellow
title: Bright Yellow Fence
irony: Ray paints the fence bright yellow to charm buyers, but the bright fence makes today so golden that home feels brightest right now.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Teddy and Hattie eye the street fence looking pale under morning sun.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy lists paint facts by the fence while Ray lifts a bright yellow can.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Constance points at the yellow can and cites a street rule about soft colors.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Teddy, Hattie and Ray chant by the fence while yellow paint splashes bright.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Hattie slaps paint fast while Teddy freezes and yellow drips hit the path.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Teddy names the dry line while Hattie brushes smooth and Ray slips with a splat.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Teddy, Hattie and Ray chant by the drippy fence while neighbours peek out.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Ray stares at the bright fence and sees Hattie glowing with joy.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Ray sets the for-sale sign down and picks up a brush beside Hattie.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Teddy, Hattie, Ray and Constance sing by the bright fence while sun hits yellow.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Teddy, Hattie and Ray admire the bright street while neighbours stop to smile.
